title: Laredo College South Campus Tree Lighting Set for Dec. 2, Free for the Community
excerpt: Laredo College will host its annual Tree Lighting Ceremony at the South Campus on Wednesday, Dec. 2, from 6 to 9 p.m., with an ice slide, a snowball fight, photos with Santa and a canned food drive for the Palomino Pantry — free and open to all.
content:
Laredo College will host its annual Tree Lighting Ceremony at the South Campus on Wednesday, Dec. 2, from 6 to 9 p.m., the college announced, as part of its 80th anniversary celebration.

The family-friendly event is expected to bring together thousands of Laredoans for an evening of festive activities, entertainment and seasonal cheer, according to the college. Admission is free and open to the community.

Along with the tree lighting, the evening will feature free attractions including an ice slide, a snowball fight and photo opportunities with Santa Claus, the college said. Student organizations will also be fundraising during the event, with snacks and light refreshments available for purchase, and proceeds will support student-led initiatives. Live dance and music performances by Laredo College students will run throughout the evening.

The college is also inviting the community to bring a canned food donation to the event for the Palomino Pantry, its student food pantry. “The start of this season is a time to celebrate, but it’s also a chance to show our Palominos how much our community supports them,” said Pedro Rivera, the college’s director of student life. He said a shelf-stable food donation can make a meaningful difference and help students stay focused on their goals.

The South Campus is at 5500 South Zapata Highway. For more information, email studentlife@laredo.edu or call (956) 721-5179, according to the college.

Sources: Laredo College, Nov. 17, 2026.
